description: Baidu's most capable LLM with strong Chinese language understanding.
longDescription: ERNIE 4.0 is Baidu's flagship large language model, excelling at Chinese and English language tasks. It demonstrates strong performance in understanding, generation, reasoning, and knowledge retrieval, making it the leading AI model in the Chinese market.

import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://aip.baidubce.com/rpc/2.0/ai_custom/v1/wenxinworkshop/chat/ernie-4.0-8k",
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    params={"access_token": "$BAIDU_ACCESS_TOKEN"},
    json={"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]}
)
print(response.json()["result"])
